rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=12, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-16 (one knob vs iter-11 best). NUMBERS: soft_thresh optimum CONFIRMED at 0.0008 (0.0006->0.3065, 0.0008->0.3088 BEST, 0.0011->0.3067). lr(7e-5), epochs(12), lambda_neg, weight_decay all mapped -> plateau ~0.309. Base = iter-11. FAILURE MODE: continuous training knobs exhausted; remaining structural lever = wu_motion_range (span of the symmetric motion search in the feature-preserving residual interp). TPE=8; wider UNTESTED. ONE KNOB: wu_motion_range 8 -> 12 (structural int, NO new params, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if I widen motion_range to 12 I expect val hr >= 0.3088 because a larger displacement search lets the residual interpolation align more of the aliasing streak structure before back-projection; risk = spurious far matches inject noise into the residual (hr down) -> range=8 confirmed. Budget: motion search is per-pixel over the sino; +50pct range modestly raises cost, still <20min (base ~735s).
